acceptance_criteria: Gesture examples are stored per profile as a versioned record with concept id, capture time, feature schema version, anchor and hands, one data name per example, through the profile store; an incompatible version is reported, never guessed

In the caregiver area a tile on the board offers 'Gebärde beibringen': the camera starts after a tap, the caregiver records an example with a tap to start and a tap to stop, sees whether it was usable (and with one or two hands), and can keep or discard it; the count per tile is shown and examples can be deleted
No video or picture is stored; only the feature sequence; examples are included in export and restore and removed with the profile
One- and two-hand gestures are both taught and stored; a recording that the matcher cannot use (too short, hands unclear, no hands) is refused in German with what to do
The profile size limit is checked when teaching opens and a refused write is reported, never retried in a loop

goal: A caregiver teaches a gesture for a tile on the child's board: in the caregiver area they record a few examples with the camera, one- or two-handed, which are stored per profile, survive export and restore, and are deleted with the profile.
